answer: Your door code will be sent by the host to you personally. Please allow 24 hours for it to be sent. You can contact the host at +92 300 555 0142 between 9:00 AM and 11:00 PM.
guest_message: I land at 3 pm. What's my door code?
evidence:
[{"source_id":"19.1","title":"The smart door lock","text":"House manual > 19. Appliance How-To Guide > 19.1 The smart door lock

The keypad is on the apartment door at handle height. Touch it with your palm to wake it, then type your 6-digit code and press **#**. A green light and a short beep mean the door is unlocked; a red light and a long beep mean the code was wrong. After three wrong tries the keypad locks itself for 5 minutes. From the inside, turn the thumb-turn knob to lock or unlock. The door locks automatically about 10 seconds after it closes. The lock runs on 4 AA batteries; if the keypad beeps three times when you wake it, the batteries are low and you should tell the host. A low battery will not lock you out immediately."},{"source_id":"3.5","title":"Self check-in","text":"House manual > 3. Getting Here and Arriving > 3.5 Self check-in

Check-in time is **2:00 PM**. The apartments use a smart keypad lock, so no one has to meet you.

1. Arrive at Gate 2 and tell the guard your apartment number. The guard will register you.
2. Take the lift to your floor.
3. On the day of arrival, once your ID is verified (and, for direct bookings, your balance is paid), the host messages you a personal 6-digit door code.
4. Touch the keypad to wake it, enter the code, then press the **#** key.

Your code works from 2:00 PM on the arrival day until 11:00 AM on the departure day. The front desk can help in person between 9:00 AM and 9:00 PM. Door codes are only ever sent by the host to the person on the booking. Nobody else, including the front desk and guards, will tell a code to anyone who asks."},{"source_id":"12.1","title":"Emergency numbers","text":"House manual > 12.
